name: Pandemic Infection
desc: Target 1 monster in your field or GY that mentions "Endless Darkness"; you lose LP equal to its ATK, and if you do, monsters your opponent controls lose an equal amount of ATK this turn. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 monster your opponent controls with 0 ATK; banish it. You can only use each effect of "Pandemic Infection" once per turn.
